_readme: THE DOSSIER — one source of truth for every application.
Every job, fellowship, grant and scholarship application asks the same
twenty things in slightly different boxes: a bio at three lengths, a
mission statement, the legal entity, the recognitions, the references.
Retyping them is where applying actually dies. This file holds the
answers once so an application is assembly, not composition.
RULE: nothing goes in here that is not verifiable. Fields marked TODO
are blank on purpose — an application is the last place to guess, and a
wrong identifier on a federal form is worse than a missing one.
Anything sensitive (EIN, UEI, CAGE, SAM registration) stays OUT of this
file. It ships with the public site. Those live in the private desk.

bios.fifty: Matthew McCluster is a creative director, photographer, web designer and songwriter working across Connecticut and Georgia. He founded McCluster Corp, a registered Connecticut public charity, and its civic fellowship Equity Uprise, work recognized in 2025 by the State of Georgia and the City of Bridgeport.
bios.oneHundred: Matthew McCluster is an American creative director, photographer, web designer and songwriter working across Connecticut and Georgia. He is the founder of McCluster Corp, a registered Connecticut public charity, and of its civic fellowship Equity Uprise, work recognized in 2025 by the State of Georgia and the City of Bridgeport with official proclamations. He owns and operates Whip Equipped LLC, organized in Acworth, Georgia in 2024. His output spans digital marketing, media production, web and platform development, and the Here / PRIM3 music catalogue, and he is the architect of the Street Credit Bureau reputation platform.

recognition.title: Connecticut General Assembly Official Citation · Matthew Christian Perry McCluster
recognition.issuer: Connecticut General Assembly, State Capitol, Hartford
recognition.signedBy: President Pro Tempore · Speaker of the House · Secretary of the State
recognition.citation: For 33 years of sustained leadership at the intersection of arts, media, and community organizing. As founder of McCluster Corp and creator of Equity Rise, he unites culture with civic action to advance youth voice, cultural and environmental equity, and religious freedom. His work demonstrates advanced professional mastery and public impact of national and international significance.
recognition.programNote: The citation names the program Equity Rise. That was the name the fellowship carried in October 2025; it operates as Equity Uprise today. The City of Bridgeport proclamation of December 10, 2025 uses the current name. The quotation above is reproduced exactly as the Assembly wrote it and has not been altered.
